invariants.title: Remote AI provider streaming & Swift AI SDK parity
invariants.description: Remote AI providers can stream text, surfaced reasoning/summary data, usage, files/sources where supported, and native tool calls through the Swift AI SDK path.

invariants.title: Swift AI SDK recursive multi-step loop authority
invariants.description: The SDK, not a parallel Hanlin loop, owns recursive multi-step tool execution for the primary agent path.

invariants.title: prepareStep dynamic tool visibility & progressive disclosure
invariants.description: prepareStep continues to support request-scoped dynamic tool visibility and Skill-driven progressive disclosure.

invariants.title: Skill-driven discovery & execution flow
invariants.description: A request can begin with only meta-tools visible, load a Skill or use tool_search, expose a previously hidden tool, execute it, return the result to the model, and continue the same agent run.

invariants.title: No hardcoded intent classifier
invariants.description: No hard-coded Swift intent classifier replaces Skill selection.

invariants.title: Stable canonical tool aliases & collision disambiguation
invariants.description: Canonical tool aliases remain stable enough for installed Skills, while collisions from different providers remain disambiguated.

invariants.title: Multi-origin canonical tool registration
invariants.description: Native/legacy tools, compiled MiniApp tools, Script tools and MCP tools can all enter the canonical authority and become agent-callable.

invariants.title: Tool activity, diagnostics & embedded results
invariants.description: Tool execution still emits progress/activity, diagnostics, user-facing presentation, evidence, embedded result payloads and durable result references where applicable.

invariants.title: NativeUIBlock & rich result family rendering
invariants.description: NativeUIBlock and every existing rich result family continues to render: maps/routes, calendar/events, health/nutrition, knowledge, code, HTML/web content, evidence/resources, images/audio, canvas, MiniApp launches and future unknown blocks.

invariants.title: Chat persistence & UI freeze contract
invariants.description: Existing chat persistence and the current chat UI contract remain unchanged: conversations, role/model metadata, attachments, activity/transcript information, rich results, message behavior and composer behavior must continue to work without a chat-UI migration.

invariants.title: Node JavaScript execution
invariants.description: Node JavaScript execution works.

invariants.title: Node TypeScript compilation & execution
invariants.description: Node TypeScript compilation/execution works.

invariants.title: JavaScriptCore lightweight execution
invariants.description: JavaScriptCore lightweight execution works where selected.

invariants.title: QuickJS scripting engine availability
invariants.description: QuickJS scripting remains available as a distinct engine.

invariants.title: Embedded CPython & package persistence
invariants.description: Embedded CPython works and package persistence survives relaunch.

invariants.title: ios_system command execution
invariants.description: ios_system-backed command execution remains agent-callable and is broadened to the real backend capabilities rather than narrowed by Hanlin policy.

invariants.title: Node package management agent tools
invariants.description: Node package preview/install/list/probe/use/uninstall works through canonical agent tools.

invariants.title: Python package management agent tools
invariants.description: Python package preview/install/list/probe/use/uninstall works through canonical agent tools.

invariants.title: MCP package lifecycle & official Swift SDK
invariants.description: MCP npm packages can be installed, registered, started in embedded Node, discovered via the official MCP Swift SDK, publish tools, execute tools, restart/recover and remain selectable per chat.

invariants.title: MCP tool-list-changed live catalog refresh
invariants.description: MCP tool-list-change notifications continue to refresh the canonical catalog.

invariants.title: Scripting package lifecycle & rollback
invariants.description: Scripting packages can import/preview/compile/install/relaunch/update/rollback/uninstall according to the package semantics that are actually implemented.

invariants.title: ScriptUI SwiftUI tree & event loop
invariants.description: ScriptUI can render its native SwiftUI tree and receive events/state updates.

invariants.title: Scripting tools canonical publication
invariants.description: Scripting tools can publish into the agent catalog and return rich/embedded results.

invariants.title: Shared HostServices across engines
invariants.description: Host services shared by engines continue to work: files, storage, network, SQLite, Apple/device services, open URL, pasteboard and assistant bridge where implemented.

invariants.title: NativeScript MiniApps (Metadata Bridge + @nativescript/core)
invariants.description: NativeScript MiniApps continue to support both direct iOS Metadata Bridge access and @nativescript/core, and can present UIKit/SwiftUI through Hanlin.

invariants.title: Expo brownfield MiniApps
invariants.description: Expo/React Native brownfield MiniApps continue to launch in their engine and coexist with the other engines.

invariants.title: Native/Swift MiniApps in Apps Hub
invariants.description: Native/Swift MiniApps continue to appear in the Apps Hub and expose tools/UI.

invariants.title: Clean cancellation & prompt re-entry
invariants.description: Cancellation stops the correct run, leaves no stale UI spinner, and a new request can start immediately.

invariants.title: Cold launch & relaunch state restoration
invariants.description: Cold launch and relaunch restore installed packages/Skills/runtime state without exposing stale tool schemas from a prior request.

invariants.title: Real runtime capability inspection
invariants.description: The agent can inspect real runtime capabilities rather than hallucinating that it is isolated merely because a schema is progressively hidden.

invariants.title: Durable result store & long output references
invariants.description: Long tool results remain retrievable through the result store/reference path without silently truncating semantic output.

invariants.title: Built-in domain tools discoverability & execution
invariants.description: Search/Sefaria/Wikipedia/Text Studio and every current built-in domain tool continue to be discoverable and callable.

invariants.title: File/document parsing & office archive extraction
invariants.description: File/document handling, PDF, ZIP-based Office extraction and web parsing remain functional.

invariants.title: Platform ergonomics: RTL, Dynamic Type, iPad multitasking
invariants.description: RTL, Dynamic Type, keyboard/pointer interaction, iPad resizing/multitasking and accessibility remain acceptable after the backend/runtime/platform changes; the chat UI itself is frozen except for minimal compatibility fixes required to keep the existing behavior working.

invariants.title: Strong functional verification requirement
invariants.description: No migration may claim success solely because it compiles. Every preserved capability must have functional evidence at the strongest practical layer.
